description: Measure how a country's IMF PPP conversion factor changed over a year window: start/end year and factor, % change, and optional min/max/avg. Use for purchasing-power trends and cross-country PPP rankings. Omit `countries` to rank all countries (movers); provide ISO alpha-3 codes to compare specific ones. Use `get_ppp_factor` for a single country/year value, and `convert` with `ppp=true` to price an amount. Defaults: 10-year window, `sort` increased, `limit` 10, `stats` true. Returns `{ from, to, mode, stats, results[] }`, with `projected: true` marking an IMF projection. Returns an error when no PPP data exists in the window. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

countries.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes to compare, e.g. IND,DEU,USA. OMIT to rank ALL countries by PPP-factor change ('movers' mode).

from.description: Window start YEAR (e.g. 2015). Defaults to 10 years before `to`. See `period` for a shorthand.

limit.description: Movers: how many top results to return (default 10, max 200).

period.description: Relative window shorthand for `from`: e.g. 10y, 20y, max. Ignored if `from` is given.

sort.description: Movers ranking: increased (PPP factor rose most, default) or decreased.

stats.description: Include min/max/avg of the PPP factor over the window per country. Defaults to true; pass false to skip.

to.description: Window end YEAR (e.g. 2024). Defaults to the current year.

name: analyze_ppp
title: PPP analysis (change, compare, movers)
